hero.name: Zaid Mahdi
hero.summary: I build polished, production-ready mobile apps focused on performance, clarity, and a smooth user experience from first launch to long-term growth.

about.label: About
about.title: About Me
about.body1: I'm Zaid, a mobile application developer with hands-on experience delivering apps that are stable, scalable, and ready for real users.
about.body2: My work combines thoughtful product design, strong architecture, and dependable integrations to create experiences that feel fast and intuitive.
about.body3: I care deeply about code quality, long-term maintainability, and continuous improvement, so every project ships with confidence and grows with ease.

skills.label: Skills
skills.title: What I work with
skills.subtitle: A focused set of tools and practices I use to build reliable, scalable mobile apps.

projects.label: Work
projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: A few projects that represent my approach — mobile-first, modern, and built to scale.

agriculture.title: Agriculture
agriculture.description: App for a company specialized in the trade of fertilizers and pesticides.

dairy.title: Dairy Unit Management
dairy.description: Comprehensive system for managing milk collection & distribution for the Ministry of Agriculture, with multi-stakeholder tracking and quality control.

diesel.title: Diesel Unit Management
diesel.description: Mobile app for monitoring national fuel inventory and distribution with real-time tracking and station management.

advisor.title: Agricultural Advisor
advisor.description: An app designed to assist farmers with agricultural guidance and recommendations.

alahally.title: Blood Donation — رابطة الاهالي
alahally.description: Connecting blood donors with recipients through a real-time donor directory with blood type search and instant notifications.

thikr.title: Islamic App — ذكر
thikr.description: A comprehensive Islamic app with Quran reading, daily Adhkar, Hadith collections, and accurate Qibla direction. Fully offline.

topmedia.title: Top Media Store
topmedia.description: A comprehensive e-commerce store with a modern Glass UI for purchasing luxury gifts and antiques, featuring order tracking and secure payments.

dhabi.title: Al Dhabi — Delivery App
dhabi.description: A comprehensive delivery platform for restaurants, groceries, and pharmacies, offering real-time order tracking and multiple payment options.
